from solution import heap_queue_smallest


def test_issue_example():
    """Example heap_queue_smallest([25, 35, 22, 85, 14, 65, 75, 25, 58], 3) is [14, 22, 25]."""
    # sorted input: [14, 22, 25, 25, 35, 58, 65, 75, 85], first 3 are 14 < 22 < 25
    expected = [14, 22, 25]
    assert heap_queue_smallest([25, 35, 22, 85, 14, 65, 75, 25, 58], 3) == expected


def test_issue_single_smallest():
    """Find the smallest integers: n=1 returns the minimum."""
    # minimum of [5, 2, 8, 1, 9] is 1 since 1 < 2 < 5 < 8 < 9
    expected = [1]
    assert heap_queue_smallest([5, 2, 8, 1, 9], 1) == expected


def test_issue_sorted_order_descending():
    """Find the smallest integers returned in ascending order."""
    # sorted [9, 8, 7, 6, 5] is [5, 6, 7, 8, 9], first 3 are 5 < 6 < 7
    expected = [5, 6, 7]
    assert heap_queue_smallest([9, 8, 7, 6, 5], 3) == expected


def test_issue_boundary_excludes_next():
    """Find the smallest integers: value just above threshold is excluded."""
    # sorted [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] is [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], first 3 are 1 < 2 < 3, 4 excluded
    expected = [1, 2, 3]
    assert heap_queue_smallest([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 3) == expected


def test_issue_duplicates_included():
    """Find the smallest integers including duplicates."""
    # sorted [4, 4, 4, 2, 2, 5] is [2, 2, 4, 4, 4, 5], first 3 are 2 == 2 < 4
    expected = [2, 2, 4]
    assert heap_queue_smallest([4, 4, 4, 2, 2, 5], 3) == expected


def test_issue_negative_numbers():
    """Find the smallest integers with negative numbers."""
    # sorted [-5, -10, 0, 5, 3] is [-10, -5, 0, 3, 5], first 2 are -10 < -5
    expected = [-10, -5]
    assert heap_queue_smallest([-5, -10, 0, 5, 3], 2) == expected


def test_issue_empty_list():
    """Find the smallest integers from an empty list returns empty."""
    # sorted [] is [], first 3 of empty is still empty: 0 elements
    expected = []
    assert heap_queue_smallest([], 3) == expected


def test_issue_n_zero():
    """Find zero smallest integers returns empty."""
    # 0 smallest from [3, 1, 2] is [] since count 0 takes none of 1 < 2 < 3
    expected = []
    assert heap_queue_smallest([3, 1, 2], 0) == expected


def test_issue_n_equals_length():
    """Find the smallest integers when n equals list length returns all sorted."""
    # sorted [3, 1, 2] is [1, 2, 3] since 1 < 2 < 3, all 3 taken
    expected = [1, 2, 3]
    assert heap_queue_smallest([3, 1, 2], 3) == expected


def test_issue_n_larger_than_length():
    """Find the smallest integers when n exceeds length returns all sorted."""
    # sorted [3, 1, 2] is [1, 2, 3] since 1 < 2 < 3, asking 5 gets all 3
    expected = [1, 2, 3]
    assert heap_queue_smallest([3, 1, 2], 5) == expected


def test_contract_returns_list():
    """Returned smallest integers are in a list."""
    # sorted [7, 3, 9, 1] is [1, 3, 7, 9], first 2 are 1 < 3
    expected = [1, 3]
    result = heap_queue_smallest([7, 3, 9, 1], 2)
    assert isinstance(result, list)
    assert result == expected


def test_contract_does_not_modify_input():
    """Finding smallest integers must not modify the input list."""
    # original [4, 1, 3, 2] stays [4, 1, 3, 2], sorted copy would be [1, 2, 3, 4]
    expected_input = [4, 1, 3, 2]
    nums = [4, 1, 3, 2]
    heap_queue_smallest(nums, 2)
    assert nums == expected_input
